rationale: The assistant correctly identified the leading possibility as a key detected as held down, gave the sensible first steps (isolate at the cooker switch, dry the panel, check for a stuck key) and explicitly warned against opening the casing. It never asked what had just happened to the panel, so it missed the cleaning history until the customer volunteered it, and hedged slightly with 'published meanings conflict' when E011 is a reasonably documented held-key code. The closing message confirmed the cause from the customer's own evidence, gave useful future-cleaning advice, and correctly set the escalation boundary (Bosch/engineer only if E011 recurs with a dry panel) with no part recommended.
